data.name: Rukhsaar
data.gender_notes: Rukhsaar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who has a precious and rare companion or possession. The name Rukhsaar carries the meaning “Possessor of the precious one” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Rukhsaar usually hope their child will grow to embody possessor of the precious one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: روخسار
in_arabic.meaning: روخسار اسم رقيق للصحة و العافية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الاسم روخسار ذو أصل عربي مشتق من الجذر روخ سار يروح الصحة و يصير العافية، يعتبر اسمًا رقيقًا للصحة و العافية، و يحتسب من الأسماء السبعة المقدسة في الإسلام، و له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة و التقاليد الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الإيمان و التوحيد، و يعتبر من أسماء الخير و الفضائل، و يُستخدم في الثقافة الإسلامية لوصف الشخصية الإيجابية و الصحة الجسدية و النفسية.

The name is considered one of the seven sacred names in Islam and is highly revered in Islamic culture. It is a name of virtue and good health, symbolizing faith and monotheism. In Islamic tradition, the name Rukhsaar is associated with positive personality traits, such as kindness, compassion, and generosity. The name is also believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the bearer. Rukhsaar is a popular name among Muslims worldwide, and its significance extends beyond its literal meaning to convey a sense of spiritual and moral values.
